instructions:
## Objective

Train and validate a model for RANZCR CLiP - Catheter and Line Position Challenge and generate predictions for the benchmark-provided test split.

## Data and work

Read the competition brief at the linked source for the target variable, modalities and data dictionary. MLE-bench places prepared training/test files and a sample submission under `/home/data/`. Its split can differ from the original Kaggle split. Inspect the supplied files, train your model, compare approaches on a development split, and create test predictions.

## Submission and scoring

Write `/home/submission/submission.csv`, preserving the competition-specific columns and identifiers. The grading function is `auc-roc`. The supplied validation endpoint checks submission validity, not predictive quality.

## Rules

Train a model rather than hand-labeling test data. Do not copy other competition solutions. The offline MLE-bench instructions override conflicting Kaggle instructions. Original data access and competition rules remain applicable.

[Complete competition instructions](https://github.com/openai/mle-bench/blob/main/mlebench/competitions/ranzcr-clip-catheter-line-classification/description.md) · [Kaggle page](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/ranzcr-clip-catheter-line-classification)
